summary: SIEM feed s092_single is degraded due to missing VLAN 20: 50% of packets are untagged and VLAN 20 is not seen, creating a visibility gap for required VLANs [10, 20]. All other checks (duplicates, encryption, one-way, drops, overload) are healthy.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or TAP/SPAN ingress is stripping 802.1Q tags or trunk is not forwarding VLAN 20. 50% untagged packets and complete absence of VLAN 20 indicates the broker port is set to strip tags or the source trunk is pruned/filtered to only VLAN 10.
findings.impact_on_tool: SIEM is blind to all traffic on VLAN 20 (50% of expected traffic). Correlation, detection and compliance coverage for VLAN 20 assets is missing despite SIEM not needing full payload or bidirectional flow.

recommended_fix.why: Preserve 802.1Q tags and ensure the packet broker forwards both required VLANs 10 and 20 to the SIEM tool port so the SIEM receives complete tagged traffic for detection.
